gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.
'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.
